instruction: How to configure ArgoCD to use an external Dex provider
output:
kubectl patch configmap argocd-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"dex.config":"connectors:
- type: oidc
  id: dex
  name: Dex
  config:
    issuer: https://dex.example.com
    clientID: argocd-client
    clientSecret: secret
    insecureEnableGroups: true"}}'

instruction: How to configure ArgoCD with SAML SSO
output:
kubectl patch configmap argocd-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"dex.config":"connectors:
- type: saml
  id: saml
  name: SAML
  config:
    ssoURL: https://saml.example.com/sso
    caPath: /etc/dex/ca.pem
    redirectURI: https://argocd.example.com/api/dex/callback"}}'

instruction: How to check the configured SSO providers in ArgoCD
output: kubectl get configmap argocd-cm -n argocd -o jsonpath='{.data.dex\.config}'

instruction: How to disable Dex in ArgoCD
output: kubectl patch configmap argocd-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"dex.config":""}}'

instruction: How to enable ArgoCD with an external OIDC provider (without Dex)
output:
kubectl patch configmap argocd-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"oidc.config":"issuer: https://accounts.example.com
clientId: argocd
clientSecret: secret
requestedScopes: ["openid", "profile", "email", "groups"]
requestedIDTokenClaims: {groups: {essential: true}}"}}'

instruction: How to view the current ArgoCD configuration
output: kubectl get configmap argocd-cm -n argocd -o yaml

instruction: How to view the current ArgoCD RBAC configuration
output: kubectl get configmap argocd-rbac-cm -n argocd -o yaml

instruction: How to configure ArgoCD RBAC for read-only users
output: kubectl patch configmap argocd-rbac-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"policy.csv":"g, my-org-readonly, role:readonly"}}'

instruction: How to configure ArgoCD RBAC for admin users from OIDC groups
output: kubectl patch configmap argocd-rbac-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"policy.csv":"g, my-org-admins, role:admin"}}'

instruction: How to set the ArgoCD RBAC scopes
output: kubectl patch configmap argocd-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"userInfo.oidc.claims.groups":"groups"}}'

instruction: How to check the ArgoCD repo server status
output: kubectl get pods -n argocd -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argocd-repo-server

instruction: How to check the ArgoCD application controller status
output: kubectl get pods -n argocd -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argocd-application-controller

instruction: How to check ArgoCD server pod status
output: kubectl get pods -n argocd -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argocd-server

instruction: How to check ArgoCD dex server status
output: kubectl get pods -n argocd -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argocd-dex-server

instruction: How to configure ArgoCD notification templates
output: kubectl apply -f argocd-notifications-cm.yaml

instruction: How to configure ArgoCD with Slack notifications
output: kubectl apply -f argocd-notifications-slack.yaml

instruction: How to test ArgoCD notifications
output: argocd notifications trigger my-app --template app-sync-status

instruction: How to list all ArgoCD notification services
output: kubectl get configmap argocd-notifications-cm -n argocd -o yaml | grep '^  service.'

instruction: How to enable ArgoCD notifications
output: kubectl patch configmap argocd-notifications-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"notifications.enabled":"true"}}'

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application that syncs to a specific cluster
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./k8s --dest-server https://cluster-1:6443 --dest-namespace default

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with a custom health check
output: kubectl apply -f app-health-check.yaml

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application that deploys a Helm chart with values
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://charts.example.com --helm-chart nginx-ingress --revision 4.0.0 --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace ingress --helm-set controller.replicaCount=3

instruction: How to list ArgoCD repositories with their type
output: argocd repo list -o json | jq '.[] | {repo: .repo, type: .type}'

instruction: How to configure ArgoCD with an image updater
output: kubectl apply -f argocd-image-updater.yaml

instruction: How to run ArgoCD image updater manually
output: argocd-image-updater run
